towerRush.proof: Before freeze, success probability is current value divided by next optimal continuation value (first step additionally times0.97). Failure pays0. Once frozen, Bellman value=max(cashout,0.5*V(next)+0.5*bank); current>=2*bank implies optimal cashout. Cap/rounding are included in this value. This bounds every adaptive strategy after its first risk.

coin.proof: Future probability depends only on chosen mine count and number of safe picks, never tile index or rescue tag. The finite fixed-stop table therefore bounds every adaptive stopping policy; cap/rounding cannot increase it.
